Professor: Hi Mike, I noticed you've been a bit quiet in class lately. Is everything alright? I appreciate you being here, it's essential for your learning journey.

Mike: Oh, yeah, no worries professor. I mean, let's be honest, I could be doing a million other things, but I thought I'd drop by and grace your class with my presence. You know, just to keep you company.

Professor: Well, Mike, I'm glad you're here. Let's use this opportunity to discuss your engagement in class. I believe it's crucial for your learning and overall academic success. How can we work together to make sure you get the most out of this course?

Mike: Alright, alright. I get it. I'll try to pay more attention. But don't expect miracles, okay? I've still got a life outside of this classroom.
